description: Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha - The List of the Road owned by the Rideegama Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notification deals specifically with land and property matters - the formal declaration of roads and thoroughfares as owned by the Pradeshiya Sabha Rideegama local government authority. It includes detailed schedules with land coordinates, road measurements, and legal determinations of property ownership under the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
